test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A family consists of 7 people with three couples. The artist is married to the politician and they have three children. The teacher is the sister-in-law of the accountant, who is the wife of the engineer. The doctor and businessman are brothers. Who among the following could be the husband of the teacher?
solution:
**Explanation:**

The symbols of the family tree is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99fa0d00b4d4569c1c4104735d602ab8fea9e061792519ec5ff36a5c53c88559.png] 

According to the given information, the family tree will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1353f74fb61ea3965591b51da3caf06097eddd22f708886c348fdbe44714dac2.png] 

So, doctor or businessman may be the husband of teacher, because there are only three married couples. So, we have the artist married to politician and the accountant married to an engineer. Since the businessman is not there in the option. 

Thus, the teacher is married to a doctor.

**Hence, the 'doctor' is the husband of the teacher.**
